outputs.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart showing median state frequency per Pol II ChIP-seq bin, aggregated across thousands of promoters per bin, with no individual promoter data points overlaid.

The single-molecule stack itself displays every individual DNA molecule (row-by-row methylation pattern) underlying the state-frequency percentages shown in the adjacent colour sidebar, so individual data points are directly visible.
Same stacked bar/area representation as panel A (median state frequencies per bin for mouse promoters) with no individual data points shown.
Same single-molecule stack representation as panel B; individual molecules are plotted directly, providing the underlying data for the summarized state frequencies.

Boxplots already display the distribution (median, IQR, whiskers) of PIC occupancy across promoters; box/violin plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points, and individual outlier points are additionally shown.
